values: v02_market_overview, forecast paragraph beginning “The market is projected…”
Link existing “Journey orchestration” in: “Journey orchestration, consent-aware customer profiles and experience assurance should attract incremental budgets…”
The paragraph explicitly treats journey orchestration as the next analytical capability purchased by the same enterprise buyers.
Add: “Teams can use digital experience analytics to measure whether those coordinated interactions improve conversion, retention and service completion.”
Measurement is the natural feedback layer for journey orchestration. The source already discusses coordinated cross-channel interactions and accountable outcomes.
v02_market_overview, after the opening paragraph's first sentence
Add: “When bot interactions span voice and messaging, customer journey orchestration can coordinate the customer's handoff between channels.”
Bots are one engagement channel; orchestration connects the bot interaction to the wider customer journey.
v02_market_overview, after the sentence listing billing, app, retail and contact-center systems
Add: “Because these interactions span billing, apps, retail and contact centers, digital experience analytics can show where subscriber journeys succeed or fail.”
The target measures the same digital touchpoints that the source says telecom operators must connect.
v02_market_overview, after the sentence about onboarding status, service history and engagement data
Add: “These engagement records can also support digital experience analytics when teams need to identify where customers disengage.”
Both reports use post-interaction data to improve retention. The link extends the reader from customer-success workflow into diagnostic measurement.

Revise to: “The market connects credit acquisition, identity verification, financial risk management, underwriting, disbursement and servicing through mobile apps, web portals and partner integrations.”
Credit acquisition and underwriting inherently require risk assessment. The target covers credit, treasury and compliance risk workflows.
Link existing “fraud detection” in: “…the commercial importance of credit decisions, fraud detection and customer analytics.”
The same sentence names banking and financial services, so the anchor has both the correct application and buyer context.
Link existing “document management” in: “Supplier registration and prequalification processes…support a monetizable opportunity in localized onboarding and document management.”
Supplier onboarding and prequalification generate documents that must be collected, controlled and retained. The paragraph names the target capability directly.
Add: “For larger organizations, intelligent process automation can extend these workflows beyond IT into onboarding, finance and compliance.”
The source covers service, operations, assets and workflows; the target extends automation into wider business processes and explicitly covers onboarding, reconciliation and compliance.
v02_market_overview, replace the sentence beginning “Buyers procure capacity…”
Revise to: “Buyers can combine device capacity and engineering support with API security testing as part of release assurance.”
Mobile applications depend on APIs. The source already frames the purchase around release assurance; the target covers API vulnerabilities and release-workflow integration.
v02_market_overview, forecast paragraph containing “basic order capture”
Revise to: “Retailers and distributors are expected to expand from basic order capture to retail inventory forecasting, inventory reservations, store-based fulfilment and returns.”
Forecasting determines what inventory should be available; order management reserves and fulfils it. The source already discusses shared stock and inventory records.
Link existing “Demand Forecasting and Inventory Analytics” in: “Demand Forecasting and Inventory Analytics is the priority growth proposition…”

This phrase clearly describes the target market and directly connects forecasting to replenishment, availability, working capital and gross profit. It is not a strict contiguous subphrase of the target title, so it needs editorial approval.
Existing text; use fuller editorial anchor
v02_market_segmentation, occurrence 3, prose paragraph beginning “Solution Type - Demand Forecasting Platforms…”
Prefer “Demand Forecasting Platforms”. The deterministic engine may shorten this to “Forecasting Platforms”.

The full phrase is more descriptive and should attract better-qualified clicks. The first two occurrences are table cells and must not be used. The prose paragraph explains purchasing commitments, planner adoption and replenishment integration.
Add: “These item-level forecasts are a key input for retail supply chain AI used in purchasing, allocation and fulfilment.”
The source produces item-level forecasts; the target applies predictive models to purchasing, stock allocation and fulfilment.
Revise “…with predictive models…” to “…with predictive AI models that inform purchasing, stock allocation and fulfilment.”
This adds one accurate qualifier already established by the source report's own title. The target is the broader platform layer that supplies predictive capability.
